subtitle: A friendly guide for international students, made by Rotary Club Lahti International.
about: Moving to a new country comes with a lot of small questions. This guide collects the answers in one place: how to get here, how to get set up, how studying works, and how to find your people. Use it on your phone, one question at a time.
whereHint: We will point you to the best first step. You can change this any time.
